units.source_text: K见我整天魂不守舍的样子，便说：‘你要是烦了，咱们就回东京吧。’

en.t: Seeing how distracted I was all day, K said, "If you are tired of this, let us go back to Tokyo."

units.source_text: 他这样一说，我忽然又不想回去了。

en.t: When he said that, I suddenly no longer wanted to go back.

units.source_text: 其实，我可能是不想让K回东京吧。

en.t: In truth, perhaps I did not want K to return to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我们绕过房州海角，去反方向的海边。

en.t: We went around the Boshū cape and came out on the shore on the opposite side.

units.source_text: 我们头顶烈日，边走边向当地人问路，人家都说去上总只有七八里路，

en.t: Under the blazing sun, we walked on asking local people the way, and everyone said Kazusa was only seven or eight ri away,

units.source_text: 可是走起来却没完没了。

en.t: but once we began walking, the road seemed endless.

units.source_text: 我简直不明白这样苦哈哈地走路，究竟有什么意义，

en.t: I could not understand at all what meaning there could be in trudging along so miserably,
so I asked K half in jest.

units.source_text: K答道：‘人有脚，就是用来走路的嘛。’

en.t: K answered, "People have feet so that they can walk."

units.source_text: 走热了，他就说一声‘下海去泡泡吧’，

en.t: When he grew hot from walking, he would say, "Let us go soak in the sea,"

units.source_text: 当即不管三七二十一，跳进海里。

en.t: and immediately, without caring about anything else, jump into the water.

units.source_text: 从海里出来后，又继续曝晒在烈日下，

en.t: After coming out of the sea, we continued on under the fierce sun again,

units.source_text: 结果我们俩都累得吃不消了。

en.t: and in the end both of us were exhausted beyond endurance.
1. Kazusa: the name of an old province.

units.source_text: 相当于现在的千叶县中部。

en.t: It corresponds to the central part of present-day Chiba Prefecture.
